def transform(grid):

    cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not cells:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c,v in cells);r1=max(r for r,c,v in cells);c0=min(c for r,c,v in cells);c1=max(c for r,c,v in cells)
    colors={v for r,c,v in cells}
    # The object has an enclosing frame color and a filled interior color.
    outer=min(colors); inner=max(colors)
    # Determine central interior rectangle by bounding all non-outer cells.
    ip=[(r,c) for r,c,v in cells if v!=outer]
    if ip:
        ir0=min(r for r,c in ip);ir1=max(r for r,c in ip);ic0=min(c for r,c in ip);ic1=max(c for r,c in ip)
    else: ir0=ir1=ic0=ic1=0
    # Extend outer rectangle by a border matching its margin-to-interior thickness,
    # colored with the inner-region color; preserve all source cells.
    top=ir0-r0; left=ic0-c0
    bottom=r1-ir1; right=c1-ic1
    pad=max(1,min(top,bottom,left,right))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-pad),min(h,r1+pad+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-pad),min(w,c1+pad+1)):
            if grid[r][c]==0:out[r][c]=inner
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not points:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    r0 = min(r for r, c, v in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c, v in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c, v in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c, v in points)
    colors = {v for _, _, v in points}
    inner = max(colors)

    # Expand the object by the short dimension of its inner patch, filling
    # the newly covered blank area with the inner color.
    inner_points = [(r, c) for r, c, v in points if v == inner]
    ih = max(r for r, c in inner_points) - min(r for r, c in inner_points) + 1
    iw = max(c for r, c in inner_points) - min(c for r, c in inner_points) + 1
    pad = min(ih, iw)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0, r0 - pad), min(h, r1 + pad + 1)):
        for c in range(max(0, c0 - pad), min(w, c1 + pad + 1)):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = inner
    return out
